title: Term Life Insurance Face Amount Decreases
content:
The owner may reduce the face amount of a Term Life Insurance policy by signed request. A face decrease is processed only while the policy status on record is in force.

| Element | Provision |
|---|---|
| Status | In force only — a policy in its grace period, lapsed or otherwise not in force is not decreased |
| When it takes effect | On the next installment due date, and only from the product's first face-decrease policy year onward |
| How many | No more than the product's limit of decreases may take effect in one policy year, counted as the face decrease requests on the policy marked completed whose decision date falls in the current policy year — from the most recent policy anniversary on or before the evaluation date to the day before the next anniversary |
| Floor | The face amount after the decrease may not be below the tier's smallest face amount |
| Premium | Recalculated under the premium calculation provisions, so a decrease that moves the face amount into a lower band also changes the band factor |
| Premium already paid | Premium already paid for the current mode period is not refunded |
| Face increase | Not available on any term tier |

### Hypothetical judgements

- Policy anniversary 1 October; one decrease completed with a decision date of 15 December; a second request in the following March falls in the same policy year and exceeds a limit of 1.
- The same second request decided after 1 October of the next year falls in a new policy year.
- An Ashgrove Level Term 20 with a face of 300000 may decrease to 100000 (the smallest face) but not to 90000.
